history.dynasty: None (traditional attribution to the 17th-century saint Samartha Ramdas; not documented)
history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: CSV town 'Nizamabad' is the city/district; the temple is at Sarangapur village, ~8 km from Nizamabad city. Local tradition holds that the saint Samartha Ramdas (guru of Chhatrapati Shivaji) laid the foundation stone over 450 years ago. The main Hanuman idol is carved on a large rock on a hillock; the temple is said to have been established after Samarth carved Hanuman's outline on the rock and prayed for rain to end a severe drought. The shrine occupies extensive grounds (reported ~1,400 acres in some accounts - verify) with gardens, accommodation and amenities for devotees; the deity is believed to grant mental and physical strength.

name: Sarangapur Hanuman Temple
town_description: Sarangapur is a village in Nizamabad district, Telangana, about 8 km from Nizamabad city. The temple stands on a rocky hillock in the village, in a well-vegetated setting that is also a macaque haven.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (~175-186 km).
travel.road: About 6.5-8 km from Nizamabad bus station; reached by cab or auto.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; early mornings are recommended for peace and to avoid crowds.
